france/staff/en/female/0/f-94d4e4c8.text: Raise your hands! You’re under arrest!
france/staff/en/female/0/f-94d4e4c8.caption: Raise your hands! You’re under arrest!

france/staff/en/female/0/f-a07e8388.text: You are not taking me anywhere.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-a07e8388.caption: You are not taking me anywhere.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-15caeb7a.text: Oh, I thought the doctor was around.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-15caeb7a.caption: Oh, I thought the doctor was around.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-5d9d6792.text: Oh, I thought I was next. Sorry about that.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-5d9d6792.caption: Oh, I thought I was next. Sorry about that.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-b0e1667c.text: You need to leave now, or I will call security.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-b0e1667c.caption: You need to leave now, or I will call security.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-979ac2af.text: Please come with me. We’re getting you out of here.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-979ac2af.caption: Please come with me. We’re getting you out of here.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-865b6285.text: I need to collect a patient file. Please wait outside.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-865b6285.caption: I need to collect a patient file. Please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-9a9d7290.text: I need to speak to a colleague. Please wait outside.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-9a9d7290.caption: I need to speak to a colleague. Please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-b449b020.text: I’m taking a short break. Please wait outside.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-b449b020.caption: I’m taking a short break. Please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-b6aef79b.text: What number are you? I thought I was next.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-b6aef79b.caption: What number are you? I thought I was next.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-455b2c34.text: Please have a seat. I'll be back in a few minutes.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-455b2c34.caption: Please have a seat. I'll be back in a few minutes.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-4554f8ce.text: Please don't do this. Please let me go!
france/staff/en/female/0/f-4554f8ce.caption: Please don't do this. Please let me go!

france/staff/en/female/0/f-afca7e5b.text: Excuse me, please wait until we finish with this patient.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-afca7e5b.caption: Excuse me, please wait until we finish with this patient.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-6676aa8.text: Finally, you’ve arrived. We were expecting Dr. Liu Wen.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-6676aa8.caption: Finally, you’ve arrived. We were expecting Dr. Liu Wen.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-cdfc1521.text: Pass me the surgical forceps, please.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-cdfc1521.caption: Pass me the surgical forceps, please.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-b8531e6a.text: Pass me the portable monitor, please.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-b8531e6a.caption: Pass me the portable monitor, please.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-4fe563ae.text: Pass me the infusion pump, please.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-4fe563ae.caption: Pass me the infusion pump, please.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-87889e69.text: That is not what I asked for. Pay attention.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-87889e69.caption: That is not what I asked for. Pay attention.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-6c9302fd.text: Hold on. Something is wrong. Take off your mask so we can verify who you are.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-6c9302fd.caption: Hold on. Something is wrong. Take off your mask so we can verify who you are.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-f159b266.text: Michael Bennett, please come to Outpatient, room one oh five.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-f159b266.caption: Michael Bennett, please come to Outpatient, room one oh five.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-108cfcca.text: Sarah Collins, please come to Cardiology, room two oh three.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-108cfcca.caption: Sarah Collins, please come to Cardiology, room two oh three.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-10a847b7.text: David Parker, please report to Neurology, room two oh four.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-10a847b7.caption: David Parker, please report to Neurology, room two oh four.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-8ec5b8fa.text: Emily Carter, please come to Rehabilitation, room three oh five.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-8ec5b8fa.caption: Emily Carter, please come to Rehabilitation, room three oh five.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-fa541e03.text: Excuse me. Please wait outside while we finish with this patient.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-fa541e03.caption: Excuse me. Please wait outside while we finish with this patient.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-21e426fe.text: I have already asked you to leave. Your presence is becoming suspicious. Please wait outside.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-21e426fe.caption: I have already asked you to leave. Your presence is becoming suspicious. Please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-1338b61b.text: You ignored both warnings. I am calling security now.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-1338b61b.caption: You ignored both warnings. I am calling security now.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-6efa560a.text: Why is everyone staring at me?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-6efa560a.caption: Why is everyone staring at me?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-2b423771.text: I thought I heard something. Maybe it was nothing.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-2b423771.caption: I thought I heard something. Maybe it was nothing.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-be20f3bb.text: Ha... okay. That was funny. For a second, I forgot where I was.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-be20f3bb.caption: Ha... okay. That was funny. For a second, I forgot where I was.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-5a0e2ae1.text: Did you finish the handover for the west wing?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-5a0e2ae1.caption: Did you finish the handover for the west wing?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-e15495d.text: Yes. The evening rounds are all written up.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-e15495d.caption: Yes. The evening rounds are all written up.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-f09bf8f9.text: I can cover your station while you take a break.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-f09bf8f9.caption: I can cover your station while you take a break.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-8621b7e5.text: Thank you. I could really use a coffee.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-8621b7e5.caption: Thank you. I could really use a coffee.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-9c628ab.text: There is another patient waiting for their results.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-9c628ab.caption: There is another patient waiting for their results.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-7cdb7330.text: I will check with the laboratory after these rounds.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-7cdb7330.caption: I will check with the laboratory after these rounds.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-34583681.text: It has been a busy night on this floor.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-34583681.caption: It has been a busy night on this floor.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-cb4fb60b.text: At least the next shift will be here soon.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-cb4fb60b.caption: At least the next shift will be here soon.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-6dc83502.text: Have you been waiting here long?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-6dc83502.caption: Have you been waiting here long?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-c86f9b9e.text: A little while. They said someone would call me soon.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-c86f9b9e.caption: A little while. They said someone would call me soon.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-d3375f5f.text: My family is bringing me a change of clothes.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-d3375f5f.caption: My family is bringing me a change of clothes.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-e55e2bdf.text: That is nice. I hope you can go home tomorrow.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-e55e2bdf.caption: That is nice. I hope you can go home tomorrow.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-907c130c.text: Would you mind passing me that magazine?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-907c130c.caption: Would you mind passing me that magazine?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-ca61ef19.text: Of course. I have already read it twice.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-ca61ef19.caption: Of course. I have already read it twice.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-ac0222d1.text: This soup is better than yesterday.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-ac0222d1.caption: This soup is better than yesterday.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-fef170bc.text: Anything tastes good after a twelve hour shift.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-fef170bc.caption: Anything tastes good after a twelve hour shift.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-109f28a3.text: No, please. I was just finishing my lunch.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-109f28a3.caption: No, please. I was just finishing my lunch.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-51a623c2.text: Do you want to share the last piece of bread?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-51a623c2.caption: Do you want to share the last piece of bread?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-ce85c5c5.text: Yes, thanks. I missed dinner again.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-ce85c5c5.caption: Yes, thanks. I missed dinner again.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-a785ded4.text: I am going to get another coffee before rounds.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-a785ded4.caption: I am going to get another coffee before rounds.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-1817c20e.text: Take a minute first. You have barely touched your food.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-1817c20e.caption: Take a minute first. You have barely touched your food.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-5d263076.text: Hi. I am here to collect my prescription.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-5d263076.caption: Hi. I am here to collect my prescription.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-1593761c.text: Of course. Can I check your name and date of birth?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-1593761c.caption: Of course. Can I check your name and date of birth?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-e5b35a96.text: Is this the queue for prescriptions?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-e5b35a96.caption: Is this the queue for prescriptions?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-602f676e.text: Yes. The pharmacist will call you to the counter.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-602f676e.caption: Yes. The pharmacist will call you to the counter.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-c2302360.text: Could you explain how I should take this?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-c2302360.caption: Could you explain how I should take this?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-6a8d5e11.text: Let us go through the label together before you leave.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-6a8d5e11.caption: Let us go through the label together before you leave.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-1a1697ef.text: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-1a1697ef.caption: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-ccf6a7a6.text: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-ccf6a7a6.caption: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-a957a36e.text: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-a957a36e.caption: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-906dda85.text: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-906dda85.caption: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-ee6524aa.text: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-ee6524aa.caption: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-64bf9e13.text: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-64bf9e13.caption: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-f1c69901.text: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-f1c69901.caption: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-37ebbf04.text: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-37ebbf04.caption: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-efbeca85.text: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-efbeca85.caption: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-69761cfd.text: All right. Tell me when I can move again.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-69761cfd.caption: All right. Tell me when I can move again.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-9bf1d565.text: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-9bf1d565.caption: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-44e43634.text: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-44e43634.caption: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-f5f13bce.text: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-f5f13bce.caption: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-9ffbd8b4.text: It hurts a little when I breathe in.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-9ffbd8b4.caption: It hurts a little when I breathe in.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-60782d26.text: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-60782d26.caption: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-8a68248c.text: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-8a68248c.caption: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-bd226516.text: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-bd226516.caption: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-ab1e0289.text: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?
france/staff/en/female/0/f-ab1e0289.caption: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?

france/staff/en/female/0/f-d5628d22.text: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-d5628d22.caption: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-7e02d7b8.text: I feel sick. I need a moment.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-7e02d7b8.caption: I feel sick. I need a moment.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-944e7e57.text: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-944e7e57.caption: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-a62e6f69.text: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-a62e6f69.caption: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-6195c494.text: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-6195c494.caption: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-9d51238e.text: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-9d51238e.caption: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-c80bc4ed.text: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-c80bc4ed.caption: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-6ebc8544.text: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-6ebc8544.caption: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-c363c3f7.text: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!
france/staff/en/female/0/f-c363c3f7.caption: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!

france/staff/en/female/0/f-9ae01c4c.text: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-9ae01c4c.caption: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-317eeeb9.text: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-317eeeb9.caption: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-41ee5a92.text: I can't trust what I'm hearing.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-41ee5a92.caption: I can't trust what I'm hearing.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-9ffb589d.text: Something isn't right. I need some air.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-9ffb589d.caption: Something isn't right. I need some air.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-b79877a5.text: La la la, la la la...
france/staff/en/female/0/f-b79877a5.caption: La la la, la la la...

france/staff/en/female/0/f-9f9ed24b.text: I knew it. They're coming for me!
france/staff/en/female/0/f-9f9ed24b.caption: I knew it. They're coming for me!

france/staff/en/female/0/f-e2715f07.text: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-e2715f07.caption: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-b8aa0ea4.text: I need help. Please, help me.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-b8aa0ea4.caption: I need help. Please, help me.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-40a23dfd.text: Sarah Collins, please report to imaging.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-40a23dfd.caption: Sarah Collins, please report to imaging.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-e297314b.text: Daniel Morgan, please come to the blood collection desk.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-e297314b.caption: Daniel Morgan, please come to the blood collection desk.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-5760d70d.text: Dr. Reed, please report to Emergency.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-5760d70d.caption: Dr. Reed, please report to Emergency.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-c1a244e0.text: Visitors, please check in at reception before entering the wards.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-c1a244e0.caption: Visitors, please check in at reception before entering the wards.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-248bd62f.text: Welcome to Nhalewick. Visitor services are located in the main atrium. Please keep all corridors clear.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-248bd62f.caption: Welcome to Nhalewick. Visitor services are located in the main atrium. Please keep all corridors clear.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-617bce9a.text: A power fault has been reported. Emergency lighting is active. Please remain calm.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-617bce9a.caption: A power fault has been reported. Emergency lighting is active. Please remain calm.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-81436742.text: Code blue. Security incident reported. All staff follow emergency protocol. Police units are responding.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-81436742.caption: Code blue. Security incident reported. All staff follow emergency protocol. Police units are responding.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-5a098bc9.text: Police response team entering the west wing. All exits will be secured shortly.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-5a098bc9.caption: Police response team entering the west wing. All exits will be secured shortly.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-48b2e826.text: Visitors: the staff directory is available in the entrance atrium. Please check department signage before proceeding.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-48b2e826.caption: Visitors: the staff directory is available in the entrance atrium. Please check department signage before proceeding.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-e5559b41.text: Attention medical staff. Please return to your assigned departments. Your next consultation is waiting.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-e5559b41.caption: Attention medical staff. Please return to your assigned departments. Your next consultation is waiting.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-3e2ccf7.text: A weapon! I am calling security!
france/staff/en/female/0/f-3e2ccf7.caption: A weapon! I am calling security!

france/staff/en/female/0/f-c9746050.text: A weapon! I am calling the police!
france/staff/en/female/0/f-c9746050.caption: A weapon! I am calling the police!

france/staff/en/female/0/f-893efc73.text: That camera is not allowed here. I am calling security.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-893efc73.caption: That camera is not allowed here. I am calling security.

france/staff/en/female/0/f-a5debc9c.text: Excuse me, I said please wait outside.
france/staff/en/female/0/f-a5debc9c.caption: Excuse me, I said please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-94d4e4c8.text: Raise your hands! You’re under arrest!
france/staff/en/female/1/f-94d4e4c8.caption: Raise your hands! You’re under arrest!

france/staff/en/female/1/f-a07e8388.text: You are not taking me anywhere.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-a07e8388.caption: You are not taking me anywhere.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-15caeb7a.text: Oh, I thought the doctor was around.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-15caeb7a.caption: Oh, I thought the doctor was around.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-5d9d6792.text: Oh, I thought I was next. Sorry about that.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-5d9d6792.caption: Oh, I thought I was next. Sorry about that.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-b0e1667c.text: You need to leave now, or I will call security.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-b0e1667c.caption: You need to leave now, or I will call security.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-979ac2af.text: Please come with me. We’re getting you out of here.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-979ac2af.caption: Please come with me. We’re getting you out of here.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-865b6285.text: I need to collect a patient file. Please wait outside.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-865b6285.caption: I need to collect a patient file. Please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-9a9d7290.text: I need to speak to a colleague. Please wait outside.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-9a9d7290.caption: I need to speak to a colleague. Please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-b449b020.text: I’m taking a short break. Please wait outside.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-b449b020.caption: I’m taking a short break. Please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-b6aef79b.text: What number are you? I thought I was next.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-b6aef79b.caption: What number are you? I thought I was next.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-455b2c34.text: Please have a seat. I'll be back in a few minutes.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-455b2c34.caption: Please have a seat. I'll be back in a few minutes.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-4554f8ce.text: Please don't do this. Please let me go!
france/staff/en/female/1/f-4554f8ce.caption: Please don't do this. Please let me go!

france/staff/en/female/1/f-10a847b7.text: David Parker, please report to Neurology, room two oh four.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-8ec5b8fa.text: Emily Carter, please come to Rehabilitation, room three oh five.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-fa541e03.text: Excuse me. Please wait outside while we finish with this patient.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-21e426fe.caption: I have already asked you to leave. Your presence is becoming suspicious. Please wait outside.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-1338b61b.text: You ignored both warnings. I am calling security now.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-1338b61b.caption: You ignored both warnings. I am calling security now.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-6efa560a.text: Why is everyone staring at me?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-6efa560a.caption: Why is everyone staring at me?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-2b423771.text: I thought I heard something. Maybe it was nothing.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-2b423771.caption: I thought I heard something. Maybe it was nothing.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-be20f3bb.text: Ha... okay. That was funny. For a second, I forgot where I was.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-be20f3bb.caption: Ha... okay. That was funny. For a second, I forgot where I was.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-5a0e2ae1.text: Did you finish the handover for the west wing?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-e15495d.text: Yes. The evening rounds are all written up.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-f09bf8f9.text: I can cover your station while you take a break.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-f09bf8f9.caption: I can cover your station while you take a break.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-8621b7e5.text: Thank you. I could really use a coffee.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-7cdb7330.text: I will check with the laboratory after these rounds.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-cb4fb60b.text: At least the next shift will be here soon.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-6dc83502.text: Have you been waiting here long?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-c86f9b9e.text: A little while. They said someone would call me soon.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-c86f9b9e.caption: A little while. They said someone would call me soon.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-d3375f5f.text: My family is bringing me a change of clothes.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-d3375f5f.caption: My family is bringing me a change of clothes.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-e55e2bdf.text: That is nice. I hope you can go home tomorrow.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-e55e2bdf.caption: That is nice. I hope you can go home tomorrow.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-907c130c.text: Would you mind passing me that magazine?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-907c130c.caption: Would you mind passing me that magazine?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-ca61ef19.text: Of course. I have already read it twice.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-ca61ef19.caption: Of course. I have already read it twice.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-ac0222d1.text: This soup is better than yesterday.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-ac0222d1.caption: This soup is better than yesterday.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-fef170bc.text: Anything tastes good after a twelve hour shift.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-fef170bc.caption: Anything tastes good after a twelve hour shift.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-109f28a3.text: No, please. I was just finishing my lunch.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-109f28a3.caption: No, please. I was just finishing my lunch.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-51a623c2.text: Do you want to share the last piece of bread?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-51a623c2.caption: Do you want to share the last piece of bread?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-ce85c5c5.text: Yes, thanks. I missed dinner again.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-ce85c5c5.caption: Yes, thanks. I missed dinner again.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-a785ded4.text: I am going to get another coffee before rounds.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-a785ded4.caption: I am going to get another coffee before rounds.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-1817c20e.text: Take a minute first. You have barely touched your food.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-1817c20e.caption: Take a minute first. You have barely touched your food.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-5d263076.text: Hi. I am here to collect my prescription.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-5d263076.caption: Hi. I am here to collect my prescription.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-1593761c.text: Of course. Can I check your name and date of birth?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-1593761c.caption: Of course. Can I check your name and date of birth?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-e5b35a96.text: Is this the queue for prescriptions?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-e5b35a96.caption: Is this the queue for prescriptions?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-602f676e.text: Yes. The pharmacist will call you to the counter.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-602f676e.caption: Yes. The pharmacist will call you to the counter.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-c2302360.text: Could you explain how I should take this?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-c2302360.caption: Could you explain how I should take this?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-6a8d5e11.text: Let us go through the label together before you leave.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-6a8d5e11.caption: Let us go through the label together before you leave.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-1a1697ef.text: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-1a1697ef.caption: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-ccf6a7a6.text: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-ccf6a7a6.caption: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-a957a36e.text: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-a957a36e.caption: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-906dda85.text: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-906dda85.caption: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-ee6524aa.text: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-ee6524aa.caption: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-64bf9e13.text: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-64bf9e13.caption: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-f1c69901.text: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-f1c69901.caption: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-37ebbf04.text: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-37ebbf04.caption: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-efbeca85.text: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-efbeca85.caption: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-69761cfd.text: All right. Tell me when I can move again.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-69761cfd.caption: All right. Tell me when I can move again.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-9bf1d565.text: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-9bf1d565.caption: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-44e43634.text: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-44e43634.caption: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-f5f13bce.text: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-f5f13bce.caption: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-9ffbd8b4.text: It hurts a little when I breathe in.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-9ffbd8b4.caption: It hurts a little when I breathe in.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-60782d26.text: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-60782d26.caption: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-8a68248c.text: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-8a68248c.caption: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-bd226516.text: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-bd226516.caption: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-ab1e0289.text: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?
france/staff/en/female/1/f-ab1e0289.caption: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?

france/staff/en/female/1/f-d5628d22.text: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-d5628d22.caption: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-7e02d7b8.text: I feel sick. I need a moment.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-7e02d7b8.caption: I feel sick. I need a moment.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-944e7e57.text: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-944e7e57.caption: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-a62e6f69.text: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-a62e6f69.caption: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-6195c494.text: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-6195c494.caption: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-9d51238e.text: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-9d51238e.caption: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-c80bc4ed.text: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-c80bc4ed.caption: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-6ebc8544.text: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-6ebc8544.caption: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-c363c3f7.text: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!
france/staff/en/female/1/f-c363c3f7.caption: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!

france/staff/en/female/1/f-9ae01c4c.text: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-9ae01c4c.caption: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-317eeeb9.text: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-317eeeb9.caption: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-41ee5a92.text: I can't trust what I'm hearing.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-41ee5a92.caption: I can't trust what I'm hearing.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-9ffb589d.text: Something isn't right. I need some air.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-9ffb589d.caption: Something isn't right. I need some air.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-b79877a5.text: La la la, la la la...
france/staff/en/female/1/f-b79877a5.caption: La la la, la la la...

france/staff/en/female/1/f-9f9ed24b.text: I knew it. They're coming for me!
france/staff/en/female/1/f-9f9ed24b.caption: I knew it. They're coming for me!

france/staff/en/female/1/f-e2715f07.text: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-e2715f07.caption: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-b8aa0ea4.text: I need help. Please, help me.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-b8aa0ea4.caption: I need help. Please, help me.

france/staff/en/female/1/f-40a23dfd.text: Sarah Collins, please report to imaging.
france/staff/en/female/1/f-40a23dfd.caption: Sarah Collins, please report to imaging.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-1a1697ef.caption: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-ccf6a7a6.text: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-ccf6a7a6.caption: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-a957a36e.text: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-a957a36e.caption: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-906dda85.text: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-906dda85.caption: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-ee6524aa.text: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?
france/staff/en/male/1/m-ee6524aa.caption: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?

france/staff/en/male/1/m-64bf9e13.text: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-64bf9e13.caption: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-f1c69901.text: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-f1c69901.caption: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-37ebbf04.text: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-37ebbf04.caption: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-efbeca85.text: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-efbeca85.caption: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-69761cfd.text: All right. Tell me when I can move again.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-69761cfd.caption: All right. Tell me when I can move again.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-9bf1d565.text: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-9bf1d565.caption: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-44e43634.text: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?
france/staff/en/male/1/m-44e43634.caption: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?

france/staff/en/male/1/m-f5f13bce.text: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-f5f13bce.caption: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-9ffbd8b4.text: It hurts a little when I breathe in.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-9ffbd8b4.caption: It hurts a little when I breathe in.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-60782d26.text: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-60782d26.caption: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-8a68248c.text: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-8a68248c.caption: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-bd226516.text: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?
france/staff/en/male/1/m-bd226516.caption: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?

france/staff/en/male/1/m-ab1e0289.text: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?
france/staff/en/male/1/m-ab1e0289.caption: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?

france/staff/en/male/1/m-d5628d22.text: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-d5628d22.caption: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-7e02d7b8.text: I feel sick. I need a moment.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-7e02d7b8.caption: I feel sick. I need a moment.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-944e7e57.text: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-944e7e57.caption: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-a62e6f69.text: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-a62e6f69.caption: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-6195c494.text: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-6195c494.caption: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-9d51238e.text: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-9d51238e.caption: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-c80bc4ed.text: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-c80bc4ed.caption: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-6ebc8544.text: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-6ebc8544.caption: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-c363c3f7.text: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!
france/staff/en/male/1/m-c363c3f7.caption: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!

france/staff/en/male/1/m-9ae01c4c.text: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-9ae01c4c.caption: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-317eeeb9.text: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-317eeeb9.caption: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-41ee5a92.text: I can't trust what I'm hearing.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-41ee5a92.caption: I can't trust what I'm hearing.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-9ffb589d.text: Something isn't right. I need some air.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-9ffb589d.caption: Something isn't right. I need some air.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-b79877a5.text: La la la, la la la...
france/staff/en/male/1/m-b79877a5.caption: La la la, la la la...

france/staff/en/male/1/m-9f9ed24b.text: I knew it. They're coming for me!
france/staff/en/male/1/m-9f9ed24b.caption: I knew it. They're coming for me!

france/staff/en/male/1/m-e2715f07.text: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-e2715f07.caption: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-b8aa0ea4.text: I need help. Please, help me.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-b8aa0ea4.caption: I need help. Please, help me.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-40a23dfd.text: Sarah Collins, please report to imaging.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-40a23dfd.caption: Sarah Collins, please report to imaging.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-e297314b.text: Daniel Morgan, please come to the blood collection desk.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-e297314b.caption: Daniel Morgan, please come to the blood collection desk.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-5760d70d.text: Dr. Reed, please report to Emergency.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-5760d70d.caption: Dr. Reed, please report to Emergency.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-c1a244e0.text: Visitors, please check in at reception before entering the wards.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-c1a244e0.caption: Visitors, please check in at reception before entering the wards.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-248bd62f.text: Welcome to Nhalewick. Visitor services are located in the main atrium. Please keep all corridors clear.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-248bd62f.caption: Welcome to Nhalewick. Visitor services are located in the main atrium. Please keep all corridors clear.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-617bce9a.text: A power fault has been reported. Emergency lighting is active. Please remain calm.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-617bce9a.caption: A power fault has been reported. Emergency lighting is active. Please remain calm.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-81436742.text: Code blue. Security incident reported. All staff follow emergency protocol. Police units are responding.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-81436742.caption: Code blue. Security incident reported. All staff follow emergency protocol. Police units are responding.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-5a098bc9.text: Police response team entering the west wing. All exits will be secured shortly.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-5a098bc9.caption: Police response team entering the west wing. All exits will be secured shortly.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-48b2e826.text: Visitors: the staff directory is available in the entrance atrium. Please check department signage before proceeding.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-48b2e826.caption: Visitors: the staff directory is available in the entrance atrium. Please check department signage before proceeding.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-e5559b41.text: Attention medical staff. Please return to your assigned departments. Your next consultation is waiting.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-e5559b41.caption: Attention medical staff. Please return to your assigned departments. Your next consultation is waiting.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-3e2ccf7.text: A weapon! I am calling security!
france/staff/en/male/1/m-3e2ccf7.caption: A weapon! I am calling security!

france/staff/en/male/1/m-c9746050.text: A weapon! I am calling the police!
france/staff/en/male/1/m-c9746050.caption: A weapon! I am calling the police!

france/staff/en/male/1/m-893efc73.text: That camera is not allowed here. I am calling security.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-893efc73.caption: That camera is not allowed here. I am calling security.

france/staff/en/male/1/m-a5debc9c.text: Excuse me, I said please wait outside.
france/staff/en/male/1/m-a5debc9c.caption: Excuse me, I said please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-94d4e4c8.text: Raise your hands! You’re under arrest!
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-94d4e4c8.caption: Raise your hands! You’re under arrest!

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-a07e8388.text: You are not taking me anywhere.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-a07e8388.caption: You are not taking me anywhere.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-15caeb7a.text: Oh, I thought the doctor was around.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-15caeb7a.caption: Oh, I thought the doctor was around.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5d9d6792.text: Oh, I thought I was next. Sorry about that.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5d9d6792.caption: Oh, I thought I was next. Sorry about that.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b0e1667c.text: You need to leave now, or I will call security.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b0e1667c.caption: You need to leave now, or I will call security.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-979ac2af.text: Please come with me. We’re getting you out of here.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-979ac2af.caption: Please come with me. We’re getting you out of here.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-865b6285.text: I need to collect a patient file. Please wait outside.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-865b6285.caption: I need to collect a patient file. Please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9a9d7290.text: I need to speak to a colleague. Please wait outside.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9a9d7290.caption: I need to speak to a colleague. Please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b449b020.text: I’m taking a short break. Please wait outside.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b449b020.caption: I’m taking a short break. Please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b6aef79b.text: What number are you? I thought I was next.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b6aef79b.caption: What number are you? I thought I was next.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-455b2c34.text: Please have a seat. I'll be back in a few minutes.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-455b2c34.caption: Please have a seat. I'll be back in a few minutes.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-4554f8ce.text: Please don't do this. Please let me go!
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-4554f8ce.caption: Please don't do this. Please let me go!

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-afca7e5b.text: Excuse me, please wait until we finish with this patient.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-afca7e5b.caption: Excuse me, please wait until we finish with this patient.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6676aa8.text: Finally, you’ve arrived. We were expecting Dr. Liu Wen.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6676aa8.caption: Finally, you’ve arrived. We were expecting Dr. Liu Wen.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-cdfc1521.text: Pass me the surgical forceps, please.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-cdfc1521.caption: Pass me the surgical forceps, please.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b8531e6a.text: Pass me the portable monitor, please.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b8531e6a.caption: Pass me the portable monitor, please.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-4fe563ae.text: Pass me the infusion pump, please.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-4fe563ae.caption: Pass me the infusion pump, please.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-87889e69.text: That is not what I asked for. Pay attention.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-87889e69.caption: That is not what I asked for. Pay attention.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6c9302fd.text: Hold on. Something is wrong. Take off your mask so we can verify who you are.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6c9302fd.caption: Hold on. Something is wrong. Take off your mask so we can verify who you are.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-f159b266.text: Michael Bennett, please come to Outpatient, room one oh five.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-f159b266.caption: Michael Bennett, please come to Outpatient, room one oh five.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-108cfcca.text: Sarah Collins, please come to Cardiology, room two oh three.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-108cfcca.caption: Sarah Collins, please come to Cardiology, room two oh three.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-10a847b7.text: David Parker, please report to Neurology, room two oh four.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-10a847b7.caption: David Parker, please report to Neurology, room two oh four.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-8ec5b8fa.text: Emily Carter, please come to Rehabilitation, room three oh five.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-8ec5b8fa.caption: Emily Carter, please come to Rehabilitation, room three oh five.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-fa541e03.text: Excuse me. Please wait outside while we finish with this patient.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-fa541e03.caption: Excuse me. Please wait outside while we finish with this patient.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-21e426fe.text: I have already asked you to leave. Your presence is becoming suspicious. Please wait outside.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-21e426fe.caption: I have already asked you to leave. Your presence is becoming suspicious. Please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-1338b61b.text: You ignored both warnings. I am calling security now.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-1338b61b.caption: You ignored both warnings. I am calling security now.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6efa560a.text: Why is everyone staring at me?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6efa560a.caption: Why is everyone staring at me?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-2b423771.text: I thought I heard something. Maybe it was nothing.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-2b423771.caption: I thought I heard something. Maybe it was nothing.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-be20f3bb.text: Ha... okay. That was funny. For a second, I forgot where I was.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-be20f3bb.caption: Ha... okay. That was funny. For a second, I forgot where I was.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5a0e2ae1.text: Did you finish the handover for the west wing?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5a0e2ae1.caption: Did you finish the handover for the west wing?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e15495d.text: Yes. The evening rounds are all written up.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e15495d.caption: Yes. The evening rounds are all written up.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-f09bf8f9.text: I can cover your station while you take a break.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-f09bf8f9.caption: I can cover your station while you take a break.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-8621b7e5.text: Thank you. I could really use a coffee.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-8621b7e5.caption: Thank you. I could really use a coffee.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9c628ab.text: There is another patient waiting for their results.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9c628ab.caption: There is another patient waiting for their results.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-7cdb7330.text: I will check with the laboratory after these rounds.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-7cdb7330.caption: I will check with the laboratory after these rounds.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-34583681.text: It has been a busy night on this floor.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-34583681.caption: It has been a busy night on this floor.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-cb4fb60b.text: At least the next shift will be here soon.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-cb4fb60b.caption: At least the next shift will be here soon.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6dc83502.text: Have you been waiting here long?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6dc83502.caption: Have you been waiting here long?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c86f9b9e.text: A little while. They said someone would call me soon.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c86f9b9e.caption: A little while. They said someone would call me soon.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-d3375f5f.text: My family is bringing me a change of clothes.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-d3375f5f.caption: My family is bringing me a change of clothes.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e55e2bdf.text: That is nice. I hope you can go home tomorrow.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e55e2bdf.caption: That is nice. I hope you can go home tomorrow.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-907c130c.text: Would you mind passing me that magazine?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-907c130c.caption: Would you mind passing me that magazine?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ca61ef19.text: Of course. I have already read it twice.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ca61ef19.caption: Of course. I have already read it twice.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ac0222d1.text: This soup is better than yesterday.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ac0222d1.caption: This soup is better than yesterday.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-fef170bc.text: Anything tastes good after a twelve hour shift.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-fef170bc.caption: Anything tastes good after a twelve hour shift.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-109f28a3.text: No, please. I was just finishing my lunch.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-109f28a3.caption: No, please. I was just finishing my lunch.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-51a623c2.text: Do you want to share the last piece of bread?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-51a623c2.caption: Do you want to share the last piece of bread?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ce85c5c5.text: Yes, thanks. I missed dinner again.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ce85c5c5.caption: Yes, thanks. I missed dinner again.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-a785ded4.text: I am going to get another coffee before rounds.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-a785ded4.caption: I am going to get another coffee before rounds.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-1817c20e.text: Take a minute first. You have barely touched your food.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-1817c20e.caption: Take a minute first. You have barely touched your food.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5d263076.text: Hi. I am here to collect my prescription.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5d263076.caption: Hi. I am here to collect my prescription.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-1593761c.text: Of course. Can I check your name and date of birth?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-1593761c.caption: Of course. Can I check your name and date of birth?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e5b35a96.text: Is this the queue for prescriptions?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e5b35a96.caption: Is this the queue for prescriptions?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-602f676e.text: Yes. The pharmacist will call you to the counter.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-602f676e.caption: Yes. The pharmacist will call you to the counter.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c2302360.text: Could you explain how I should take this?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c2302360.caption: Could you explain how I should take this?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6a8d5e11.text: Let us go through the label together before you leave.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6a8d5e11.caption: Let us go through the label together before you leave.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-1a1697ef.text: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-1a1697ef.caption: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ccf6a7a6.text: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ccf6a7a6.caption: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-a957a36e.text: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-a957a36e.caption: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-906dda85.text: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-906dda85.caption: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ee6524aa.text: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ee6524aa.caption: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-64bf9e13.text: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-64bf9e13.caption: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-f1c69901.text: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-f1c69901.caption: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-37ebbf04.text: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-37ebbf04.caption: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-efbeca85.text: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-efbeca85.caption: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-69761cfd.text: All right. Tell me when I can move again.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-69761cfd.caption: All right. Tell me when I can move again.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9bf1d565.text: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9bf1d565.caption: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-44e43634.text: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-44e43634.caption: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-f5f13bce.text: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-f5f13bce.caption: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9ffbd8b4.text: It hurts a little when I breathe in.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9ffbd8b4.caption: It hurts a little when I breathe in.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-60782d26.text: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-60782d26.caption: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-8a68248c.text: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-8a68248c.caption: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-bd226516.text: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-bd226516.caption: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ab1e0289.text: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-ab1e0289.caption: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-d5628d22.text: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-d5628d22.caption: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-7e02d7b8.text: I feel sick. I need a moment.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-7e02d7b8.caption: I feel sick. I need a moment.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-944e7e57.text: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-944e7e57.caption: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-a62e6f69.text: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-a62e6f69.caption: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6195c494.text: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6195c494.caption: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9d51238e.text: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9d51238e.caption: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c80bc4ed.text: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c80bc4ed.caption: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6ebc8544.text: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-6ebc8544.caption: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c363c3f7.text: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c363c3f7.caption: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9ae01c4c.text: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9ae01c4c.caption: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-317eeeb9.text: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-317eeeb9.caption: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-41ee5a92.text: I can't trust what I'm hearing.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-41ee5a92.caption: I can't trust what I'm hearing.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9ffb589d.text: Something isn't right. I need some air.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9ffb589d.caption: Something isn't right. I need some air.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b79877a5.text: La la la, la la la...
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b79877a5.caption: La la la, la la la...

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9f9ed24b.text: I knew it. They're coming for me!
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-9f9ed24b.caption: I knew it. They're coming for me!

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e2715f07.text: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e2715f07.caption: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b8aa0ea4.text: I need help. Please, help me.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-b8aa0ea4.caption: I need help. Please, help me.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-40a23dfd.text: Sarah Collins, please report to imaging.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-40a23dfd.caption: Sarah Collins, please report to imaging.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e297314b.text: Daniel Morgan, please come to the blood collection desk.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e297314b.caption: Daniel Morgan, please come to the blood collection desk.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5760d70d.text: Dr. Reed, please report to Emergency.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5760d70d.caption: Dr. Reed, please report to Emergency.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c1a244e0.text: Visitors, please check in at reception before entering the wards.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c1a244e0.caption: Visitors, please check in at reception before entering the wards.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-248bd62f.text: Welcome to Nhalewick. Visitor services are located in the main atrium. Please keep all corridors clear.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-248bd62f.caption: Welcome to Nhalewick. Visitor services are located in the main atrium. Please keep all corridors clear.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-617bce9a.text: A power fault has been reported. Emergency lighting is active. Please remain calm.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-617bce9a.caption: A power fault has been reported. Emergency lighting is active. Please remain calm.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-81436742.text: Code blue. Security incident reported. All staff follow emergency protocol. Police units are responding.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-81436742.caption: Code blue. Security incident reported. All staff follow emergency protocol. Police units are responding.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5a098bc9.text: Police response team entering the west wing. All exits will be secured shortly.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-5a098bc9.caption: Police response team entering the west wing. All exits will be secured shortly.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-48b2e826.text: Visitors: the staff directory is available in the entrance atrium. Please check department signage before proceeding.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-48b2e826.caption: Visitors: the staff directory is available in the entrance atrium. Please check department signage before proceeding.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e5559b41.text: Attention medical staff. Please return to your assigned departments. Your next consultation is waiting.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-e5559b41.caption: Attention medical staff. Please return to your assigned departments. Your next consultation is waiting.

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-3e2ccf7.text: A weapon! I am calling security!
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-3e2ccf7.caption: A weapon! I am calling security!

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c9746050.text: A weapon! I am calling the police!
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-c9746050.caption: A weapon! I am calling the police!

nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-893efc73.text: That camera is not allowed here. I am calling security.
nigeria/staff/en/female/0/f-893efc73.caption: That camera is not allowed here. I am calling security.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-94d4e4c8.text: Raise your hands! You’re under arrest!
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-94d4e4c8.caption: Raise your hands! You’re under arrest!

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-a07e8388.text: You are not taking me anywhere.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-a07e8388.caption: You are not taking me anywhere.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-15caeb7a.text: Oh, I thought the doctor was around.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-15caeb7a.caption: Oh, I thought the doctor was around.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-5d9d6792.text: Oh, I thought I was next. Sorry about that.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-5d9d6792.caption: Oh, I thought I was next. Sorry about that.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b0e1667c.text: You need to leave now, or I will call security.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b0e1667c.caption: You need to leave now, or I will call security.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-979ac2af.text: Please come with me. We’re getting you out of here.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-979ac2af.caption: Please come with me. We’re getting you out of here.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-865b6285.text: I need to collect a patient file. Please wait outside.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-865b6285.caption: I need to collect a patient file. Please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9a9d7290.text: I need to speak to a colleague. Please wait outside.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9a9d7290.caption: I need to speak to a colleague. Please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b449b020.text: I’m taking a short break. Please wait outside.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b449b020.caption: I’m taking a short break. Please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b6aef79b.text: What number are you? I thought I was next.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b6aef79b.caption: What number are you? I thought I was next.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-455b2c34.text: Please have a seat. I'll be back in a few minutes.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-455b2c34.caption: Please have a seat. I'll be back in a few minutes.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-4554f8ce.text: Please don't do this. Please let me go!
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-4554f8ce.caption: Please don't do this. Please let me go!

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-afca7e5b.text: Excuse me, please wait until we finish with this patient.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-afca7e5b.caption: Excuse me, please wait until we finish with this patient.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6676aa8.text: Finally, you’ve arrived. We were expecting Dr. Liu Wen.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6676aa8.caption: Finally, you’ve arrived. We were expecting Dr. Liu Wen.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-cdfc1521.text: Pass me the surgical forceps, please.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-cdfc1521.caption: Pass me the surgical forceps, please.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b8531e6a.text: Pass me the portable monitor, please.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b8531e6a.caption: Pass me the portable monitor, please.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-4fe563ae.text: Pass me the infusion pump, please.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-4fe563ae.caption: Pass me the infusion pump, please.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-87889e69.text: That is not what I asked for. Pay attention.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-87889e69.caption: That is not what I asked for. Pay attention.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6c9302fd.text: Hold on. Something is wrong. Take off your mask so we can verify who you are.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6c9302fd.caption: Hold on. Something is wrong. Take off your mask so we can verify who you are.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-f159b266.text: Michael Bennett, please come to Outpatient, room one oh five.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-f159b266.caption: Michael Bennett, please come to Outpatient, room one oh five.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-108cfcca.text: Sarah Collins, please come to Cardiology, room two oh three.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-108cfcca.caption: Sarah Collins, please come to Cardiology, room two oh three.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-10a847b7.text: David Parker, please report to Neurology, room two oh four.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-10a847b7.caption: David Parker, please report to Neurology, room two oh four.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-8ec5b8fa.text: Emily Carter, please come to Rehabilitation, room three oh five.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-8ec5b8fa.caption: Emily Carter, please come to Rehabilitation, room three oh five.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-fa541e03.text: Excuse me. Please wait outside while we finish with this patient.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-fa541e03.caption: Excuse me. Please wait outside while we finish with this patient.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-21e426fe.text: I have already asked you to leave. Your presence is becoming suspicious. Please wait outside.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-21e426fe.caption: I have already asked you to leave. Your presence is becoming suspicious. Please wait outside.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-1338b61b.text: You ignored both warnings. I am calling security now.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-1338b61b.caption: You ignored both warnings. I am calling security now.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6efa560a.text: Why is everyone staring at me?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6efa560a.caption: Why is everyone staring at me?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-2b423771.text: I thought I heard something. Maybe it was nothing.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-2b423771.caption: I thought I heard something. Maybe it was nothing.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-be20f3bb.text: Ha... okay. That was funny. For a second, I forgot where I was.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-be20f3bb.caption: Ha... okay. That was funny. For a second, I forgot where I was.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-5a0e2ae1.text: Did you finish the handover for the west wing?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-5a0e2ae1.caption: Did you finish the handover for the west wing?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-e15495d.text: Yes. The evening rounds are all written up.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-e15495d.caption: Yes. The evening rounds are all written up.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-f09bf8f9.text: I can cover your station while you take a break.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-f09bf8f9.caption: I can cover your station while you take a break.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-8621b7e5.text: Thank you. I could really use a coffee.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-8621b7e5.caption: Thank you. I could really use a coffee.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9c628ab.text: There is another patient waiting for their results.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9c628ab.caption: There is another patient waiting for their results.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-7cdb7330.text: I will check with the laboratory after these rounds.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-7cdb7330.caption: I will check with the laboratory after these rounds.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-34583681.text: It has been a busy night on this floor.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-34583681.caption: It has been a busy night on this floor.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-cb4fb60b.text: At least the next shift will be here soon.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-cb4fb60b.caption: At least the next shift will be here soon.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6dc83502.text: Have you been waiting here long?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6dc83502.caption: Have you been waiting here long?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-c86f9b9e.text: A little while. They said someone would call me soon.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-c86f9b9e.caption: A little while. They said someone would call me soon.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-d3375f5f.text: My family is bringing me a change of clothes.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-d3375f5f.caption: My family is bringing me a change of clothes.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-e55e2bdf.text: That is nice. I hope you can go home tomorrow.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-e55e2bdf.caption: That is nice. I hope you can go home tomorrow.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-907c130c.text: Would you mind passing me that magazine?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-907c130c.caption: Would you mind passing me that magazine?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ca61ef19.text: Of course. I have already read it twice.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ca61ef19.caption: Of course. I have already read it twice.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ac0222d1.text: This soup is better than yesterday.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ac0222d1.caption: This soup is better than yesterday.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-fef170bc.text: Anything tastes good after a twelve hour shift.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-fef170bc.caption: Anything tastes good after a twelve hour shift.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-109f28a3.text: No, please. I was just finishing my lunch.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-109f28a3.caption: No, please. I was just finishing my lunch.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-51a623c2.text: Do you want to share the last piece of bread?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-51a623c2.caption: Do you want to share the last piece of bread?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ce85c5c5.text: Yes, thanks. I missed dinner again.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ce85c5c5.caption: Yes, thanks. I missed dinner again.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-a785ded4.text: I am going to get another coffee before rounds.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-a785ded4.caption: I am going to get another coffee before rounds.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-1817c20e.text: Take a minute first. You have barely touched your food.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-1817c20e.caption: Take a minute first. You have barely touched your food.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-5d263076.text: Hi. I am here to collect my prescription.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-5d263076.caption: Hi. I am here to collect my prescription.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-1593761c.text: Of course. Can I check your name and date of birth?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-1593761c.caption: Of course. Can I check your name and date of birth?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-e5b35a96.text: Is this the queue for prescriptions?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-e5b35a96.caption: Is this the queue for prescriptions?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-602f676e.text: Yes. The pharmacist will call you to the counter.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-602f676e.caption: Yes. The pharmacist will call you to the counter.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-c2302360.text: Could you explain how I should take this?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-c2302360.caption: Could you explain how I should take this?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6a8d5e11.text: Let us go through the label together before you leave.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6a8d5e11.caption: Let us go through the label together before you leave.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-1a1697ef.text: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-1a1697ef.caption: Excuse me! This is a delivery room. Please give her some privacy.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ccf6a7a6.text: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ccf6a7a6.caption: Oh! Please wait outside. We are looking after a mother.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-a957a36e.text: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-a957a36e.caption: Excuse me. We are examining a patient.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-906dda85.text: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-906dda85.caption: Oh! I did not hear you come in. Please wait by the door.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ee6524aa.text: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ee6524aa.caption: Oh! Excuse me. Can I help you?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-64bf9e13.text: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-64bf9e13.caption: I am going to check your temperature. Please hold still for a moment.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-f1c69901.text: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-f1c69901.caption: Okay. I have been feeling hot and cold all afternoon.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-37ebbf04.text: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-37ebbf04.caption: Open your mouth a little, please. This will only take a second.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-efbeca85.text: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-efbeca85.caption: Let your arm rest here. The cuff will feel a little tight.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-69761cfd.text: All right. Tell me when I can move again.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-69761cfd.caption: All right. Tell me when I can move again.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9bf1d565.text: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9bf1d565.caption: Just a few more seconds. Keep breathing normally.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-44e43634.text: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-44e43634.caption: Is it supposed to squeeze this much?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-f5f13bce.text: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-f5f13bce.caption: Take a slow breath in for me. And breathe out.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9ffbd8b4.text: It hurts a little when I breathe in.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9ffbd8b4.caption: It hurts a little when I breathe in.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-60782d26.text: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-60782d26.caption: I am going to listen to your heart. Try to relax your shoulders.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-8a68248c.text: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-8a68248c.caption: Okay, doctor. My heart has been racing.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-bd226516.text: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-bd226516.caption: Could I have something for the pain? Maybe Acamol?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ab1e0289.text: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-ab1e0289.caption: My head is spinning. Can someone help me sit down?

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-d5628d22.text: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-d5628d22.caption: Please, can you call the nurse? The pain is getting worse.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-7e02d7b8.text: I feel sick. I need a moment.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-7e02d7b8.caption: I feel sick. I need a moment.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-944e7e57.text: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-944e7e57.caption: What was that noise? It came from down the hall.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-a62e6f69.text: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-a62e6f69.caption: That sounded wrong. I am going to check.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6195c494.text: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6195c494.caption: My heart is racing. Something is wrong. I need somewhere quiet.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9d51238e.text: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9d51238e.caption: Come with me. We can talk away from the corridor.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-c80bc4ed.text: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-c80bc4ed.caption: Why are they watching me? Tell me what is going on.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6ebc8544.text: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-6ebc8544.caption: This hospital is evil. They're plotting against you and me. We have to kill them.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-c363c3f7.text: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-c363c3f7.caption: I knew it wasn't just in my head. Let's do it!

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9ae01c4c.text: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9ae01c4c.caption: You're lying to me. You want to set me up. I'm leaving.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-317eeeb9.text: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-317eeeb9.caption: Stay here. Breathe slowly. I am going alone.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-41ee5a92.text: I can't trust what I'm hearing.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-41ee5a92.caption: I can't trust what I'm hearing.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9ffb589d.text: Something isn't right. I need some air.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9ffb589d.caption: Something isn't right. I need some air.

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b79877a5.text: La la la, la la la...
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-b79877a5.caption: La la la, la la la...

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9f9ed24b.text: I knew it. They're coming for me!
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-9f9ed24b.caption: I knew it. They're coming for me!

nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-e2715f07.text: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.
nigeria/staff/en/female/1/f-e2715f07.caption: I'm burning up, I can't breathe.
